The '''Imperial Resources Base''' was a large [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Klerint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deysum III]]. It covered a nine square kilometer area, and housed three hundred buildings including [[Sector Planning]] and a headquarters for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. The base was responsible for all military and civilian planning relating to [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]].
